fun_facts: Byrum Brown attended Rolesville High School in his hometown of Rolesville, North Carolina.
In 2023, he totaled 4,101 yards for USF, becoming only the second quarterback in the program’s history to reach 4,000 total yards in a season.
In 2025, he became the 12th FBS quarterback to record both 3,000 passing yards and 1,000 rushing yards in a season.
In a 2026 game against Southern Miss, Brown rushed for 88 yards as part of Auburn’s first trio of players to each rush for 80 or more yards in a game since 2019.
Against Arkansas in 2026, he threw for 180 yards and ran for 120, totaling 300 yards of offense.

# Byrum Brown's 300 yards of total offense power Auburn in 26-23 victory over Arkansas

* * *

By AP

Updated: Nov 7, 2026, 07:20 pm

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

AUBURN, Ala. -- — [Byrum Brown](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4880272/byrum-brown) threw for 180 yards with two touchdowns and ran for another 120 yards as Auburn defeated Arkansas 26-23 on Saturday.

[Alex McPherson](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4870519/alex-mcpherson) , the hero of the Auburn-Georgia game, kicked his second game-winning field goal of the season. McPherson kicked the 42-yarder with only 33 seconds left, forcing Arkansas into a desperation moment they couldn't convert.

After a slow first half, Auburn (5-4, 3-4 Southeastern Conference) used the momentum of a field goal right before halftime to score 23 points in the second half.
